name: Celia Cumani Aintree
original_name: スィーリア・クマーニ・エイントリー
source:
Celia was the winner of the jousting competitions during both her first and second year at the academy and is regarded as a prodigy in jousting. Celia also has excellent grades and has been the president of the student council for consecutive years.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walkure_Romanze]Wikipedia[/url]]
